response.overview: Three best friends, A troubled newcomer Zero, A hot-headed delinquent Atlas, and a sports prodigy Ace, are forced apart during a horrific spirit attack right before graduation. Forced to fight in a violent ever changing world, Atlas and Ace join the Psychic Safety Division. But beneath the surface, a greater evil lurks, pulling the strings and initiating the end of existence as we know it... Project: Eclipse.
response.tagline: Tomorrow the sun sets for the final time.
response.title: Project: Eclipse
